title: Write the five stub page files
description:
## Objective
Create slides/pages/ with one stub per section, each holding its exact slide count so the total is right from the first build.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-deck-foundation/2026-08-13-deck-foundation-spec.md` — Section: "2. Write the stub pages"

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/pages/01-problem.md` (2 slides), `02-model.md` (5), `03-commands.md` (4), `04-example.md` (4), `05-setup.md` (3)

## Implementation
1. One '## <title>' per slide, titles taken from the outline table in the iteration plan.
2. One 'TODO' line under each heading.
3. Separate slides with --- on its own line.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build`
Do NOT close until it exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: cd slides && npm run build exits 0
